meta.name: agent-harness
meta.description: Turn any domain folder of skills into a bounded agentic loop: compile a goal into a verifiable task plan, execute tasks with the domain's own tools, verify every task with machine-run checks, retry with caps, escalate to a human when budgets exhaust, and refuse to close until everything is verified or explicitly waived. Use when you want an agent or subagent to pick up a goal and drive it to a verified close across one of this repo's 18 domains ('run this goal through the engineering harness', 'set up an agentic loop for marketing work', 'make the finance domain self-verifying'). NOT for authoring Claude Code Workflow-tool .js scripts (workflow-builder), N-agent tournaments on one task (agenthub), single-file metric optimization (autoresearch-agent), or discovering published loop recipes (loop-library).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把任意技能文件夹变成可验证的自主执行循环
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让一组技能自动完成目标并逐项验证结果
copy.tagline_en: Turn any skill folder into a verifiable autonomous execution loop
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a set of skills to autonomously achieve a goal with step-by-step verification

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把目标拆成带检查的任务清单,用该领域的工具逐个执行,并用机器检查验证每一项;失败会按上限重试,预算耗尽就转交人工,未全部验证或豁免前不会宣布完成。
howto.when: 当你想让代理或子代理接手一个目标,在该技能的 18 个领域之一运行并验证到收尾时触发,例如「用工程 harness 跑这个目标」。

say.text: 用工程 harness 跑这个目标:审计支付服务并设计带错误预算的 SLO。
say.note: 会先问澄清问题,拒绝模糊目标。

say.text: 给营销工作搭一个 agentic loop,做到每项任务都被验证。
say.note: 逐任务执行,并由控制器验证。

say.text: 为财务领域建立自验证闭环,跑完 harness 流程。
say.note: 需要该领域的清单文件。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude turns a goal into a checked plan, executes tasks with domain tools, verifies each via machine checks, retries within caps, escalates when budgets run out, and won't close until all tasks verified or waived.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask an agent or subagent to take a goal and drive it to verified close within one of the repo's 18 domains, e.g. 'run this goal through the engineering harness'.

say_en.text: Run this goal through the engineering harness.
say_en.note: It asks clarifying questions first and rejects vague goals.

say_en.text: Set up an agentic loop for marketing work with verified tasks.
say_en.note: Tasks run one at a time and are verified by the controller.

say_en.text: Make the finance domain self-verifying and run it through the harness.
say_en.note: Needs that domain's manifest in place.
